rationale: Identity verification was properly done using full name and zip. However, the agent made multiple policy and accuracy errors: (1) Claimed both orders with tablets were delivered without clear tool support; later the tool explicitly returned “non-delivered order cannot be returned” for order #W3069600, contradicting the agent’s earlier statement. (2) Attempted to initiate a return on a non-delivered order, which is ineligible per policy. (3) Asserted that the silver tablet return had been submitted and was in “return requested” status with refund to the credit card, despite tool feedback that returns were not allowed due to non-delivery; this is unsupported/fabricated. (4) Provided final information that the silver tablet return would proceed to the credit card, which is likely incorrect given the tool error. While the agent did obtain explicit confirmation before writes and acted on the correct user’s account, the incorrect actions and unsupported statements mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
